title: 2004 AMC 10A Problem 2
statement: For any three real numbers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c,\) with \(b \neq c,\) the operation \(\diamond\) is defined by \[\diamond(a, b, c) = \dfrac{a}{b - c}.\] What is \(\diamond(\diamond(1, 2, 3), \diamond(2, 3, 1), \diamond(3, 1, 2))?\)

solutions.text:
The inner values are \[ \begin{aligned} \diamond(1,2,3) &= \dfrac{1}{2-3} = -1, \\ \diamond(2,3,1) &= \dfrac{2}{3-1} = 1, \\ \diamond(3,1,2) &= \dfrac{3}{1-2} = -3. \end{aligned} \]

Therefore \[ \begin{aligned} \diamond(-1, 1, -3) &= \dfrac{-1}{1 - (-3)} \\ &= -\dfrac{1}{4}. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Evaluate the three inner expressions before combining them
